name: Belmond Jimbaran Puri
positioning: Beach resort on Jimbaran Bay in Bali, officially called Jimbaran Puri, with a Balinese village feel and its own temples
best_for: Couples who want romantic dinners and a beach setting
Travelers who want a Balinese beach base close to the airport
Families who want a children's pool

facts.text: Jimbaran Puri is a beach resort in Bali that combines tradition, culture and nature.
The resort sits between the jungle and the beach on Jimbaran Bay.
Accommodation includes cottage suites, pool villas and deluxe pool villas.
Rooms feature teak wood detailing and cotton upholstery.
The resort has two destination restaurants, Nelayan and Tunjung, and the Puri beach bar.
In-room dining is available upon request.
The hotel spa has views of Jimbaran Bay.
The resort has a luxury boutique.
The resort hosts intimate weddings, with beach, garden and indoor venues.
The resort is 7km from Ngurah Rai Airport (DPS).

highlights.text: The resort has four open-air Hindu temples for worship: Telega, Surya, Baruna and Guardian.
Nelayan is a restaurant with views of Jimbaran Bay.
Romantic dinners for two and private BBQ grill experiences are offered.
The resort has an infinity pool and a children's pool.

considerations.text: Ubud is a 1 hour 30 minutes drive from the resort, so it is a beach base rather than a base for Ubud.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the Belmond brand positioning.
WhataHotel notes the traditional cottage design may have fewer modern amenities than contemporary resorts.
